summary: Dividend Income module testing completed successfully. All 9 features tested and working: navigation from Income Type to My Dividend, empty state, create dividend with Direct Stocks/Quarterly, REITs info note, conditional fields for Quarterly (quarter + date selectors), decimal units field, category badge display in list, edit with confirmation, delete with confirmation.

issues: Minor React hydration warnings in console for span inside select/option - cosmetic only, does not affect functionality

critical_code_review_comments: DividendIncome.js (695 lines): File size is within acceptable limits
sourceCategory field correctly implemented with 5 options: Direct Stocks, Mutual Funds (IDCW), REITs, InvITs, Others
units field correctly implemented as Optional[float] in backend model (server.py:73)
Frequency options correctly limited to: Quarterly, Half-Yearly, Yearly, Irregular (no Daily/Weekly/Monthly)
REITs/InvITs info note correctly shows conditional warning about regulated distributions
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
Category color badges correctly implemented with distinct colors for each source category
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_TCS_Stock, TEST_Embassy_REIT, and various TEST_ prefixed dividends during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dividend Income module fully tested. All CRUD operations working. Key features: sourceCategory field with 5 options, units field is optional and accepts decimals, REITs/InvITs show special info note, only 4 frequency options (Quarterly, Half-Yearly, Yearly, Irregular). Backend uses generic /api/income endpoints with type='Dividend'.

test_1_navigation_income_to_dividend.details: Clicking Dividend card on Income Type page navigates to /my-dividend

test_2_empty_state.details: Empty state shows 'Add New Dividend' button (data-testid='add-dividend-empty-button')

test_3_create_direct_stocks_quarterly.details: Created dividend with Direct Stocks category and Quarterly frequency. Dividend appears in list with correct data and category badge.

test_4_reits_info_note.details: REITs category correctly shows info note: 'Note: REITs and InvITs distributions are regulated and may include interest, dividend, or capital repayment components.' InvITs also shows same note. Direct Stocks correctly hides note.

test_5_quarterly_conditional_fields.details: Quarterly frequency correctly shows quarter selector (Q1-Q4) and date selector (1-31)

test_6_optional_units_decimal.details: Units field accepts decimal values (tested with 150.75). Field is optional and marked as (Optional) in UI.

test_7_category_badge_display.details: Dividend list shows category badges with correct colors (Direct Stocks: blue, REITs: green, etc.)

test_8_edit_dividend.details: Edit mode shows Update Dividend and Delete buttons. Update confirmation dialog works. Amount successfully updated from 5,000 to 8,500 and persisted.

test_9_delete_dividend.details: Delete confirmation dialog shows dividend name 'TEST_TCS_Stock'. Cancel and Yes, Delete buttons work. Dividend removed from list after deletion.
